data_metadata.rul_definition: post-FPT (end_index-t)/(end_index-FPT); pre-FPT masked; true endpoint only used as label
data_metadata.classification_label: derived from causal 3-sigma FPT, not expert fault-type annotation
data_metadata.normalization: per-window per-channel z-score; raw RMS only creates labels and is not model input
limitations: 健康状态分类标签由HI/FPT派生，不能当作人工故障类型真值
chronological模式测试同一轴承后期，不能证明跨轴承泛化
每轴承初始健康记录用于参考和基线校准，属于明确的可用启动信息
融合HI、平滑、基线长度等是为缺失细节补充的实现选择
